text:
Recommended synthesis: define the paired estimand on identical user–prefix pairs where both replacement procedures succeed and both metrics are defined: E[M_A−M_B | common support]. State whether prefixes or users receive equal weight; for user weighting, average paired differences within users first. Bootstrap users within categories, retaining all their prefixes and paired measurements, then recompute the four-category macro-average. Report eligible users/prefixes and support rates. User-level resampling preserves within-user dependence ([cluster-bootstrap methods](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7148287/)). Complete-case estimates describe the retained population; generalization can fail when matching success depends on history characteristics or effect modifiers. Compare retained/excluded histories; weighting requires justified selection assumptions and positivity ([selection-bias analysis](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7705610/)).

Keep zero-outranker coverage undefined; assigning zero or one changes the estimand. Separately report paired transitions: zero→zero, zero→positive, positive→zero, positive→positive. Report coverage differences on jointly defined cases alongside outranker-count or target-rank changes on all successfully matched pairs. Distinguish structural undefinedness from replacement failure; report failure reasons and rates without imputing nonexistent replacements. These are proposed diagnostic design choices, rather than a published recommender-specific prescription.

With fixed candidate catalogs, bootstrap intervals are conditional on those catalogs. To assess negative-sampling uncertainty separately, repeat candidate draws inside each user/prefix, sharing each draw across paired conditions. Separate between-user variation from within-user Monte Carlo variation; inner repeats are not additional users. Avoid adding Monte Carlo variance again if a nested procedure already includes it ([nested variance estimation](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-9909/3/3/31)). Repeated draws improve precision for the sampled-candidate estimand; they do not remove its discrepancy from full-catalog ranking ([sampled-metric analysis](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).
